d:
There were no front doors in Çatalhöyük. No streets either. To get home you walked across your neighbours' roofs and climbed down a ladder, and the dead were buried under your floor. In 2025, the DNA of 131 of them told a story nobody expected.

So play along. You're born in this town in Türkiye about 9,000 years ago. Five moments of your life, five guesses: would you make it through? And watch the list of what the world was told about this place: the first city, 8,000 people, a Mother Goddess, the oldest map, a town ruled by women. Some of it survives the evidence. Some of it doesn't.

Every photo of the site, a wall painting, a figurine or a bone is real. The flights over the town and inside a house are a reconstruction by ZDF/Terra X (CC BY 4.0). Graphics are labelled ILLUSTRATION.
